title: Premature Builder Patterns
pattern: Implementing a verbose builder pattern for a tiny struct with only 1 or 2 mandatory fields.
why_bad: Forces developers to maintain an entire auxiliary struct, state accumulation methods, and complex builders when a direct constructor is infinitely simpler.
detection: Builder pattern implemented for structs containing very few fields (e.g., less than 3) that are always required.
counterexample: Structs with 5+ optional fields where construction requires a safe, step-by-step configuration.
fix: Remove the builder struct and provide a direct `new` constructor.
